project_name: FreightOS Phase 1 Dispatcher Operations Web App
context: Hackathon Stage Demo for a small trucking fleet 'Demo West Freight' with 4 trucks in California (Truck 101, Truck 102, Truck 103, Truck 104). Focused on real-time AI dispatch, route optimization, return-load decisioning, simulated broker negotiations, and workflow automation.

layout_architecture.structure: Fixed-height viewport (100vh) non-scrolling parent shell with 3-column layout: Nav Rail + Main Canvas Area + Contextual Right Drawer Panel

nav_rail.position: fixed left-0 top-0 bottom-0 z-40 flex flex-col items-center py-4

elements: Brand Logo + Fleet Name 'Demo West Freight' + '4 trucks' badge
Status Summary Pill ('3 Active Loads · 1 Idle')
'Talk to FreightOS' Voice Toggle Mic Button with live sound wave glow
Notifications Bell with red badge (popover list)

main_content.padding: p-4 space-y-4 flex-1 flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-64px)] overflow-hidden
main_content.attention_strip: bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-amber-900 shadow-sm shrink-0
main_content.center_workspace: flex-1 grid grid-cols-12 gap-4 min-h-0 relative
main_content.map_canvas_area: col-span-12 relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm border border-[#E2E8F0] bg-[#FAF8F5] flex-1 flex flex-col

map_overlay_controls.top_right: AI Activity Summary Pill ('AI Dispatcher Active · Scanning 14 return loads in CA')
map_overlay_controls.bottom_left: Route Legend (Confirmed Solid / Proposed Dashed Indigo / Empty Dotted Grey)

main_content.bottom_command_bar: sticky bottom-0 z-30 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-lg flex items-center gap-3

contextual_right_panel.behavior: Slide-in from right overlay or side column (only ONE panel open at a time)
panel_types: truck_detail: Truck 102 Telematics, Driver photo, Fuel 68%, HOS remaining, Active route
return_load_decision: AI recommended return loads for Truck 101 in Bakersfield, Profit Margin comparison, Accept/Counter CTA
broker_call_transcript: Simulated audio call player + live transcript with broker C.H. Robinson, sentiment tag, rate negotiation
ai_conversation: Interactive chat with FreightOS AI copilot
metric_breakdown: Detailed breakdown for Booked Revenue / Fuel Costs / Empty Miles
activity_feed: Real-time event log of dispatcher actions & driver updates
document_viewer: Rate Confirmation PDF preview / Bill of Lading

status_stepper_pattern.styling: Horizontal step bar with soft indigo filled circles for completed steps, pulsating glow ring for active step, and muted grey lines for upcoming steps.

visual_enhancers.shimmer_effect: animate-pulse bg-gradient-to-r from-[#4351AC]/10 via-[#95E8CA]/30 to-[#4351AC]/10 bg-[length:200%_100%]
visual_enhancers.voice_waveform: Animated CSS bars / canvas equalizer reacting to mic active state

data_testid_convention.rule: Every button, input, tab, metric card, map marker, panel toggle, and key metric element MUST have a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React + JS with Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + Lucide React icons.
Ensure map is initialized via MapLibre GL with CARTO Positron light vector tiles or Leaflet fallback with CARTO tile layer so it loads instantly without needing an API key.
Implement interactive state switches for all 4 trucks (101, 102, 103, 104) on map and right side panels.
Keep command bar strictly at bottom without blocking map controls.
Provide interactive voice simulation toggle with waveform visualizer and speech audio simulation.
Ensure all interactive components carry explicit data-testid attributes for testing.
Make sure hover states don't rely on inherited text colors and explicitly specify text colors on hover.
Follow single indigo accent (#4351AC) for primary CTAs and soft lavender/grey background (#F0F0F7).
